problems_addressed.specific_problem: Ineffectiveness of time blocking every hour
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Focus on managing energy rather than time; prioritize high-energy tasks like prospecting in the morning.
Implement a 411 referral model: four calls per year, one direct mail per month, and one digital contact per week.
Develop a buyer consultation process and raise personal standards to attract serious clients.

episode_summary: In this episode, Nick Schleckaway shares insights on managing energy over time, consistent prospect generation, and the importance of maintaining high standards in real estate. He discusses the 411 referral model and how luxury is more about service standards than price points. The episode is packed with actionable strategies for agents aiming to elevate their business.
